mentions.name: Wanes
mentions.description: This iOS app provides a symptom logging interface for Apple Health that tracks how long symptoms last. It starts a Live Activity for one or more symptoms using widgets, Control Center, or Siri, allows changing the severity rating while the activity runs, and lets users stop tracking from anywhere on the phone (Home Screen, Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, Siri).
mentions.problem: Apple Health's built-in symptom data entry is limited; the author gets frequent headaches and wanted a better way to track symptom duration and severity.
mentions.source_excerpt: Wanes[2], an Apple Health logging interface for tracking how long symptoms last. I tend to have headaches quite often and the way Apple lets you enter that data is pretty limited, so I created an app which starts a Live Activity for one or more symptoms using widgets, Control Center or Siri. You can change the severity rating while it runs and stop it from wherever you are on your phone (Home Screen, Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, Siri).
